```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dpi=5000, out.width="90%", fig.height = 4.8, fig.width = 6,  fig.cap= ""}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyr)
library(grid)

# =========================================================
# Conceptual matrices
# Low: strong overlap with honeybees
# High: reduced overlap + shift to an alternative plant
# =========================================================

M_low <- matrix(
  c(1.2, 0,
    1.0, 1.2,
    0.9, 3.2),
  nrow = 3,
  byrow = TRUE
)

M_high <- matrix(
  c(2.5, 0,
    2.5, 0,
    2.5, 0.5,
    0.0, 1.2,
    0.0, 1.8),
  nrow = 5,
  byrow = TRUE
)

set_dimnames <- function(M) {
  colnames(M) <- c("Apis", "Poll1")
  rownames(M) <- paste0("Plant", seq_len(nrow(M)))
  M
}

M_low  <- set_dimnames(M_low)
M_high <- set_dimnames(M_high)

# =========================================================
# Build panel
# =========================================================
build_scenario <- function(M, title) {
  
  edges <- as.data.frame(as.table(M)) %>%
    rename(
      Plant = Var1,
      Pollinator = Var2,
      Weight = Freq
    ) %>%
    filter(Weight > 0)
  
 plants <- data.frame(
  name = rownames(M),
  x = 0,
  y = seq(1, nrow(M))
) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("P", seq_len(n())))
 
if (nrow(M) == 3) {
  poll_y <- c(1.5, 2.5)   # Low panel
} else if (nrow(M) == 5) {
  poll_y <- c(2.0, 4.0)   # High panel
} else {
  mid_y <- mean(range(plants$y))
  offset <- 0.75
  poll_y <- c(mid_y - offset, mid_y + offset)
}

polls <- data.frame(
  name = colnames(M),
  x = 1,
  y = poll_y,
  label = NA

)
  nodes <- rbind(plants, polls)
  
  edges_xy <- edges %>%
    left_join(nodes, by = c("Plant" = "name")) %>%
    rename(x1 = x, y1 = y) %>%
    left_join(nodes, by = c("Pollinator" = "name")) %>%
    rename(x2 = x, y2 = y) %>%
    mutate(
      Pollinators = ifelse(Pollinator == "Poll1", "Wild pollinator", "Honeybee")
    )
  
  polls <- polls %>%
    mutate(
      Pollinators = ifelse(name == "Poll1", "Wild pollinator", "Honeybee")
    )
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_segment(
      data = edges_xy,
      aes(
        x = x1, y = y1,
        xend = x2, yend = y2,
        linewidth = Weight,
        alpha = Weight,
        color = Pollinators
      ),
      lineend = "round",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Wild pollinator" = viridis(3)[2],
      "Honeybee" = "#E69F00"
    )) +
    scale_linewidth(range = c(0.6, 3.2)) +
    scale_alpha(range = c(0.08, 0.82), guide = "none") +
    
    geom_point(
      data = plants,
      aes(x = x, y = y, shape = "Plant"),
      size = 8,
      color = "gray53",
      fill  = "gray53",
      stroke = 1
    ) +
    geom_text(
  data = plants,
  aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
  nudge_x = -0.18,
  size = 4,
  color = "gray25",
  fontface = "bold"
) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Plant" = 22),
      labels = c("Plant" = "Plant")
    ) +
    
    geom_point(
      data = polls,
      aes(x = x, y = y, color = Pollinators),
      size = 8
    ) +
    
    guides(
      linewidth = "none",
      size = "none",
      colour = guide_legend(
        order = 1,
        title = NULL,
        override.aes = list(
          size = 6,
          alpha = 1,
          stroke = 1,
          linewidth = 0
        )
      ),
      shape = guide_legend(
        order = 2,
        title = NULL,
        override.aes = list(
          size = 6,
          color = "gray53",
          fill  = "gray53",
          shape = 22
        )
      )
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin  = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1.25),
      plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15)
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.12)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.12)) +
    ggtitle(title)
}

# =========================================================
# Build plots
# =========================================================
p_low  <- build_scenario(M_low,  "Low")
p_high <- build_scenario(M_high, "High")

networks_row <- p_low | p_high

# =========================================================
# Bottom arrow only
# =========================================================
triangle_bottom <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = data.frame(
      x = c(0, 1, 0),
      y = c(-0.8, -0.5, 0.2)
    ),
    aes(x, y),
    fill = alpha("#5F7F7A", 0.2),
    color = "#5F7F7A",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5, y = 0.6,
    label = "Wild pollinator overlap with honeybees and specialization",
    fontface = "bold", size = 5.2
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(0, 1),
    ylim = c(-0.35, 1.2),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(8, 5, 10, 5)
  )


title_top <- ggplot() +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5, y = 0.14,
    label = "Honeybee dominance",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 6
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_void()

# =========================================================
# Final plot
# =========================================================
final_plot <- title_top / networks_row / triangle_bottom +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(2,6, 1.35),
    guides  = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 5, l = 0),
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt")
  )

final_plot
```
